gaps.explanation: p6 governmental funds statement: Issuance of debt 147,730,000 is printed only in the Nonmajor Governmental Funds column (General, Debt Service, Grants, Street and Highway all '-'). Detail counted by the gap = Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax Fund 'Issuance of debt' 4,435,000 (p32) + GOCVB 'Issuance of long-term lease' 494,174 (p27; the statement's lease row, which the JSON keeps in other_financing, not debt_proceeds) = 4,929,174. Adding the Nonmajor cell 147,730,000 would double count Riverfront's 4,435,000, and adding only 147,730,000 - 4,435,000 = 143,295,000 would be a derived figure. The 143,295,000 was issued by nonmajor funds that have no budget schedule in the trim (the combining nonmajor statements are not trimmed). No fix.

p6 other financing rows not in detail: Proceeds on sale of capital assets 4,969,923, printed only in the Nonmajor Governmental Funds column; no nonmajor budget schedule prints such a row, so no part of it is in detail - added. Not added: Premium on debt issued Nonmajor 12,082,268 (Riverfront's 605,064, p32, is already in detail; the rest would be a derived remainder); Debt Service Fund premium 432,424 and GOCVB lease 494,174 are already in detail. No mislabelled transfer lines.
